dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY with REPLACING, INDEXED files, LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM, and CALL to ORCA subsystem routines
evidence: SELECT ... ASSIGN RECE46PARA ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM PIC X(256)
STOP RUN / EXIT PROGRAM conditional on SHELLID
Japanese comments and JMA copyright header

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system — specifically the workers' compensation and automobile liability (労災・自賠責) monthly receipt detail file creation and摘要欄 (remarks column) sort/edit processing
purpose.summary: ORCR0470 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that reads an indexed receipt detail file (RECE46), transforms and sorts the remarks-column (摘要欄) entries for workers' compensation and automobile liability receipts, and writes the results to another indexed file (RECE47). It handles diagnosis classification codes, cancellation processing, and various receipt format variants.

notable_features: INDEXED file I/O with SEQUENTIAL and DYNAMIC access modes
COPY with REPLACING for record layout reuse
LINKAGE SECTION / USING COMMAND-PARAM (called as subprogram or standalone)
Conditional STOP RUN vs EXIT PROGRAM based on SHELLID
Japanese multi-byte characters in comments and literals (UTF-8)
14 COPY statements for modular include files
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars (~27% of file); remaining procedure division not visible but mechanical indicators confirm full 4-division structure. Long lines slightly exceed 72 cols (5 lines) but format is otherwise fixed. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS. COMP-3 absent despite financial/medical domain — likely handled in copybooks.
